command:
set -u
printf 'IDENTITY host=%s user=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(id -un)"
printf 'SELF_INTEGRATION_BEGIN\n'
cd /home/andreas/self-integration || exit 40
printf 'HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'STATUS_BEGIN\n'; git status --porcelain=v1; printf 'STATUS_END\n'
for f in werkzeug/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py werkzeug/entityos-vm-volatile-state-guard.conf werkzeug/entityos-vm-semantic-cutover.conf werkzeug/semantic-state-schutz-installieren.sh; do if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then sha256sum "$f"; else printf 'MISSING_SOURCE %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
printf 'SELF_INTEGRATION_END\n'
printf 'INSTALLED_BEGIN\n'
for f in /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf; do if sudo -n test -f "$f"; then sudo -n sha256sum "$f"; else printf 'MISSING_INSTALLED %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
printf 'SYSTEMD_BEGIN\n'
systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager
printf 'SYSTEMD_END\n'
printf 'SEMANTIC_SOURCE_PRESENCE_BEGIN\n'
for f in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do if sudo -n test -f "$f"; then sudo -n stat -c 'PRESENT %n bytes=%s mtime=%y' "$f"; else printf 'MISSING %s\n' "$f"; fi; done
printf 'SEMANTIC_SOURCE_PRESENCE_END\n'
